## Description

Primary source:

<https://ngs101.com/how-to-analyze-single-cell-rna-seq-data-complete-beginners-guide-part-4-cell-type-identification/>

Part 2 of 3. Three automated annotation approaches are run on the object saved
by part 1:

- **SingleR**: reference-based (correlation to labelled reference profiles); the
  article recommends `MonacoImmuneData` for PBMCs (HPCA is broad, DICE is less
  granular).
- **scType**: marker-based gene set scoring per cluster.
- **scCATCH**: tissue-specific marker database matching per cluster.

No single method is authoritative. Part 3 compares them.

## Libraries and directories

```{r step1_libs_data}

# Core single-cell analysis
library(Seurat)              # Main scRNA-seq toolkit
library(SeuratObject)        # Seurat object infrastructure

# Annotation packages
library(SingleR)             # Reference-based annotation
library(celldex)             # Reference datasets
library(scCATCH)             # Tissue-specific marker matching
library(SingleCellExperiment) # SCE objects
library(HGNChelper)          # Gene symbol checking, used by scType
library(openxlsx)            # Reads scType database

# Visualization and data manipulation
library(ggplot2)             # Custom plots when needed
library(patchwork)           # Combine plots
library(dplyr)               # Data manipulation

if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  # Running interactively (e.g. via "Run Cell") rather than through
  # knit/render, so `params` was never created by rmarkdown::render().
  # Reconstruct it by parsing this .Rmd's own YAML header, so the params
  # defaults live in exactly one place (the YAML block above) instead of
  # being duplicated here.
  rmd_path <- tryCatch(
    # Only reliable when this document is the active editor tab; if focus
    # has moved to another file, this will pick up the wrong path.
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path,
    error = function(e) NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(rmd_path) || !nzchar(rmd_path)) {
    # Fallback if rstudioapi is unavailable or no doc is focused; assumes
    # the working directory is the project root.
    rmd_path <- "scRNAseq_tutorial_4_cell_type_annotation/tut4_cell_type_annotation_part2.Rmd"
  }
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(rmd_path)$params
}

# Set working directory
base.dir <- params$base.dir
annot.dir <- file.path(base.dir, params$annot.subdir)

# Create output directories
for (d in c("plots/automated_annotation", "annotations")) {
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(annot.dir, d))) dir.create(file.path(annot.dir, d), recursive = TRUE)
}

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(params$seed)

# Configure plotting defaults
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

cluster.col <- params$cluster.col

# Files from part 1 and for part 3
annotated_part1.file <- "integrated_manual_annotated_seurat.rds"
annotated_part2.file <- "integrated_automated_annotated_seurat.rds"

if (params$species != "human") {
  warning("SingleR references and scType/scCATCH databases below are set up for human data; review before using species = '", params$species, "'")
}
```

## Load object from part 1

```{r step2_load_obj}
integrated_seurat <- readRDS(file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", annotated_part1.file))
load(file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", "annot_part1.RData")) # umap_reduction, cluster_to_celltype

DefaultAssay(integrated_seurat) <- "RNA"
Idents(integrated_seurat) <- cluster.col
cat("Cells:", ncol(integrated_seurat), " UMAP reduction:", umap_reduction, "\n")
```

## SingleR: reference-based annotation

SingleR compares the expression of each cell with labelled reference profiles
and assigns the best-correlated label. It cannot assign a type that is absent
from the reference.

```{r step3_singler, message = FALSE}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: SingleR with three references
#-----------------------------------------------

sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(integrated_seurat)

singler_refs <- list(
  hpca   = celldex::HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData(),
  monaco = celldex::MonacoImmuneData(),
  dice   = celldex::DatabaseImmuneCellExpressionData()
)

singler_results <- lapply(singler_refs, function(ref) {
  SingleR(test = sce, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main, assay.type.test = "logcounts")
})

for (nm in names(singler_results)) {
  integrated_seurat[[paste0("singler_", nm)]] <- singler_results[[nm]]$labels
}

stopifnot(params$singler.ref %in% names(singler_results))
integrated_seurat$singler_annotation <- integrated_seurat[[paste0("singler_", params$singler.ref)]][, 1]
```

### Compare the three references

```{r step4_singler_compare, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
ref_plots <- lapply(names(singler_results), function(nm) {
  DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = paste0("singler_", nm),
          label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, label.size = 3, pt.size = 0.1) +
    ggtitle(paste("SingleR:", nm)) + NoLegend()
})
p_ref <- wrap_plots(ref_plots, ncol = 2)
print(p_ref)
ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/automated_annotation/singler_reference_comparison.png"),
       p_ref, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = params$plot.dpi)

for (nm in names(singler_results)) {
  cat("\n", nm, "- number of labels:", length(unique(integrated_seurat[[paste0("singler_", nm)]][, 1])), "\n")
  print(sort(table(integrated_seurat[[paste0("singler_", nm)]][, 1]), decreasing = TRUE))
}
```

```{r step5_singler_save}
write.csv(data.frame(cell_barcode = colnames(integrated_seurat),
                     cluster = integrated_seurat@meta.data[[cluster.col]],
                     integrated_seurat@meta.data[, paste0("singler_", names(singler_results))]),
          file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/singler_annotations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## scType: marker-based gene set scoring

Each cell's scaled expression is scored against positive (and negative) marker
sets for each cell type in the database, scores are summed per cluster, and
each cluster takes its top-scoring type.

```{r step6_sctype_load, message = FALSE}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 7: Load scType functions and marker database
#-----------------------------------------------

source(file.path(params$sctype.fn_url, "gene_sets_prepare.R"))
source(file.path(params$sctype.fn_url, "sctype_score_.R"))

sctype.db <- file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", "ScTypeDB_full.xlsx")
if (!file.exists(sctype.db)) {
  download.file(params$sctype.db_url, sctype.db, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
}

gs_list <- gene_sets_prepare(sctype.db, params$sctype.tissue)
cat("Cell types in database for", params$sctype.tissue, ":", length(gs_list$gs_positive), "\n")
```

```{r step7_sctype_score, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 8: Score cells and assign cluster-level types
#-----------------------------------------------

scaled_data <- as.matrix(LayerData(integrated_seurat, layer = "scale.data"))

es_max <- sctype_score(scRNAseqData = scaled_data, scaled = TRUE,
                       gs = gs_list$gs_positive, gs2 = gs_list$gs_negative)

clusters <- as.character(integrated_seurat@meta.data[[cluster.col]])
cell_ids <- colnames(integrated_seurat)

cL_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(clusters), function(cl) {
  es_cl <- sort(rowSums(es_max[, cell_ids[clusters == cl], drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(cluster = cl, type = names(es_cl)[1], scores = es_cl[[1]],
             ncells = sum(clusters == cl), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# Low-scoring clusters are labelled "Unknown"
score_threshold <- quantile(cL_results$scores, params$sctype.unknown_quantile)
cL_results$type_raw <- cL_results$type
cL_results$type[cL_results$scores < score_threshold] <- "Unknown"
print(cL_results[order(as.numeric(cL_results$cluster)), ], row.names = FALSE)

integrated_seurat$sctype_annotation <- cL_results$type[match(clusters, cL_results$cluster)]

write.csv(cL_results, file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/sctype_cluster_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_sctype <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = "sctype_annotation",
                    label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.1) + ggtitle("scType")
print(p_sctype)
ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/automated_annotation/umap_sctype.png"),
       p_sctype, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
```

Note: with `sctype.unknown_quantile = 0.6`, roughly 60% of clusters will be
labelled `Unknown` by construction, since the cutoff is relative to the other
clusters' scores. Lower the quantile (or use a fixed cutoff) if that is too
aggressive.

## scCATCH: tissue-specific automated annotation

scCATCH finds cluster-specific marker genes and matches them to a curated
tissue-specific database (`cellmatch`).

```{r step8_sccatch, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 9: scCATCH
#-----------------------------------------------

sccatch_species <- c(human = "Human", mouse = "Mouse")[[params$species]]

obj_sccatch <- createscCATCH(data = LayerData(integrated_seurat, layer = "data"),
                             cluster = clusters)

obj_sccatch <- findmarkergene(object = obj_sccatch,
                              species = sccatch_species,
                              marker = cellmatch,
                              tissue = params$sccatch.tissue,
                              cancer = params$sccatch.cancer,
                              cell_min_pct = params$sccatch.cell_min_pct,
                              logfc = params$sccatch.logfc,
                              pvalue = params$sccatch.pvalue)

obj_sccatch <- findcelltype(obj_sccatch)

sccatch_celltype <- obj_sccatch@celltype
print(sccatch_celltype[, intersect(c("cluster", "cell_type", "celltype_score"), colnames(sccatch_celltype))],
      row.names = FALSE)

sccatch_lookup <- setNames(as.character(sccatch_celltype$cell_type), as.character(sccatch_celltype$cluster))
integrated_seurat$sccatch_annotation <- unname(sccatch_lookup[clusters])
integrated_seurat$sccatch_annotation[is.na(integrated_seurat$sccatch_annotation) |
                                       integrated_seurat$sccatch_annotation == "Unclassified"] <- "Unknown"

write.csv(sccatch_celltype, file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/sccatch_cluster_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(obj_sccatch@markergene, file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/sccatch_marker_evidence.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_sccatch <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = "sccatch_annotation",
                     label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.1) + ggtitle("scCATCH")
print(p_sccatch)
ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/automated_annotation/umap_sccatch.png"),
       p_sccatch, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
```
